question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Jokes and funny remarks amongst friends.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Banter**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Banter **refers to the playful and friendly exchange of teasing remarks. (छेड़छाड़)

 
 
• **Example**: The old friends enjoyed a lively **banter **during their reunion.
 
 
 
• **Banter **perfectly fits as a one-word substitute for jokes and funny remarks amongst friends, matching the description given.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is "**Banter**".

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Discussion **means the action or process of talking about something in order to reach a decision or to exchange ideas. (चर्चा)
 
• **Meet **can refer to an organized event, such as a sports match, or simply the act of coming into the presence or company of someone by chance or arrangement. (मिलना)
 
• **Saunter **means to walk in a slow, relaxed manner, without hurry or effort. (टहलना)
